Nina Park: heads-up  after swapping to the int8-fast kernel for q5b we saw a spike in dedupe misses on the code promptset. many pairs are only whitespace/paren differences so anchors get missed.
Ethan Liu: sample from golden: expected `def add(a,b):
` vs got `def add (a, b):` small whitespace token diff flips fingerprint. which kernel rolled?
Nina Park: rolled cf9d2e. tokenizer unchanged. token-diff on a 100-sample slice shows ~5.2% whitespace-boundary deltas.
Maya Singh: annotation queue saw 28 reassigns for duplicate-miss. ops-bot flagged CI failure.
ops-bot: CI job 9012: golden-anchor-recall degraded from 0.96 -> 0.88.
Ethan Liu: propose: add a `kernel-impact` gating job in onboarding that computes normalized vs raw hashes and a small `code-format-suite` gate. if whitespace-delta > 2% fail the kernel swap.
Maya Singh: agree. implement normalization that preserves raw variants for UI display so labelers can still judge formatting.
Nina Park: will upload 25 code golden cases to gs://curation/gold/code-format-suite and open PR with the `kernel-impact` CI job. pinging eng-runtime for opt-in kernel flips until gate passes.
Ethan Liu: thanks team. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/curate/pulls/1490. Retro tomorrow 10am to decide hash policy. :calendar:
